brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.requirement: Wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins
requirements.evidence: 3 bins placed: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full across three adjacent full hex bases forming a horizontal rack
2 keyhole hangers installed: accessory:0#-1,0#1 and accessory:0#-1,0#2 on the wall-facing slots of piece -1,0,0;full, with joint bolts securing the 3-piece assembly

finish.summary: Built a horizontal wall-hung spice rack from 3 full hex bases (q -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0) each fitted with a full-depth bin (3 total), secured with joint bolts, and hung via 2 keyhole hangers on the wall side. Mesh check clear with no errors.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
